faq_intro: Answers to the most common questions about the platform.
faq: How do I enroll in a course?
Open the course page, click “Enroll”, then follow the payment instructions (Mobile Money, bank transfer). Access opens as soon as the administration validates your proof of payment.
How long does payment validation take?
Usually less than one business day. You receive a notification as soon as access is confirmed.

How do I get a certificate?
Complete all lessons and pass the course assessments. The certificate is then issued and can be publicly verified with its number.
How do I become an instructor?
Submit an application from the “Become an instructor” page. Once approved you can create courses; they are published after review by the administration.
How do I attend a live bootcamp?
Lives are announced in the Bootcamps section. Register, then join the room at the scheduled time.
privacy: We collect the information needed to run the service: identity, email address, learning progress, payment proofs and support exchanges.
This data is used to manage your account, validate enrollments, issue certificates and improve the platform. It is never sold.
Data is kept for the lifetime of your account, protected by restricted access and hashed passwords.
You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to contact@devopsakademy.cloud.
